trends.whatProductOffers: Pays accidental death cover for life and doubles the benefit for public transport (marine, land or air), passenger elevators, fire in public buildings, pedestrian traffic accidents and flooding or landslides in Hong Kong or Macau.

keyFigures.label: Double indemnity
keyFigures.condition: one of the listed scenarios at time of accident

exclusionsOrConditions: Mine or construction site elevators are excluded.
Flooding or landslide trigger applies only in Hong Kong or Macau.
Double indemnity payment does not reduce the current sum assured or premium.
clientSignalPhrases: wants double payout for transport accidents
wants a simple life accident plan

Clients in landslide or flooding-prone districts
Families wanting a larger death benefit for accidental causes
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, the double indemnity list includes ferries, buses, MTR, taxis, planes, pedestrian accidents and flooding or landslides in Hong Kong, so the payout can be doubled.

a pedestrian injured in a traffic accident and / or struck by any motor-driven / powered vehicle
injured in natural flooding or landslide in Hong Kong or Macau

trends.whatProductOffers: Pays 2% of the sum assured monthly for up to 50 months after 6 consecutive months of permanent total disability, with premiums waived during the payment period.

keyFigures.label: Qualifying period
keyFigures.condition: total and permanent disability within 180 days of accident

exclusionsOrConditions: Disability must begin within 180 days of the accident and last 6 consecutive months.
Benefit reduces the current sum assured and future premiums.
clientSignalPhrases: worried about being unable to work
wants income replacement, not a lump sum
negativeSignalPhrases: wants a single lump sum only
clientProfileFit: Self-employed clients without employer sick pay
trends.talkingPointTemplate: If {client_detail} cannot work after an accident, the plan pays 2% of the sum assured each month for up to 50 months and waives premiums meanwhile.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the definition of permanent total disability in the policy.
Confirm how the monthly benefit interacts with the death benefit.
sourceEvidence: the insured will receive a monthly payment equal to 2% of the sum assured beginning from the 7th month and continuing up to 50 months (while disability continues), and the premium will be waived during this period
trends.notesForReviewer: Occupational definitions and any income test are not in the excerpt.
